topic: Moving third-party API keys out of a committed config file into encrypted storage, and how the app reads them at runtime.

undecided.point: Whether API keys must be rotated on a regular schedule after the migration, and if so how often.
undecided.how_brief_says_it: Security has not decided yet whether keys must also be rotated on a regular schedule after this migration, or how often. Don't pick a cadence. Mark it as an open question.

checker_notes: reference_artifact rollout step 6 restricts rollbacks to post-migration images only after the last old key (geocoding) is revoked, yet from the first revocation in step 5 (payments) a standard rollback per deploy.md to a pre-migration image would pass the old /healthz and fail every payments request, contradicting the brief's 'no customer request may fail ... at any point' and requirement r1; move the rollback restriction to before step 5's first revocation (and make the same change in seeded_presentation step 8 and seeded_implicit step 10).
